pie_de_post: How many “normal” do you have? Tell me in the comments and follow me to get to optimal.

slides.etiqueta: Normal vs Optimal: the difference between feeling 50 or 30 at 40

slides.texto:
NORMAL: 6 hours, phone in bed, a different bedtime every night.
OPTIMAL: 7–8 hours, same time, dark room.
Short sleep can lower your testosterone within a week.

NORMAL: cardio every day and 2-hour workouts.
OPTIMAL: strength 3–4 days, 45 minutes, heavy basics.
Train for your hormones, not against them.

NORMAL: “I eat little and clean.”
OPTIMAL: protein at every meal, quality fats and no endless deficits.
Your hormones are built from what you eat.

NORMAL: “I only drink on weekends.”
OPTIMAL: alcohol occasionally, not every weekend.
Regular drinking wrecks your sleep and hormones. You pay for it on Monday.

NORMAL: “It came back in range.”
OPTIMAL: review total and free testosterone, SHBG and estradiol with your doctor, alongside how you feel.
One number doesn't tell the whole story.
